PRESIDENT'S ORDER 2 OF 1985
PRESIDENT'S ORDER
2 OF 1985
HOUSES OF
PARLIAMENT AND PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLIES (ELECTIONS) (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 1985
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary Part I, 12th January, 1985]
No.. F. 17 (3)/85-Pub.-The
following Order- made by the President is hereby, published for general
information :-
In pursuance of the proclamation
of the fifth day of July, 1977, and in exercise of all powers enabling him in
that behalf, the President is pleased to make the following Order :-
1. Short title and commencement.-(1) This Order may be called the Houses of Parliament and
Provincial Assemblies (Elections) (Amendment) Order, 1985.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.
2. Amendment of Article 4, P. (P. P.) O. No. 5 of 1977.--In
the Houses of Parliament and Provincial Assemblies (Elections) Order, 1977 [P.
(P. P.) O. No. 5 of 1977], hereinafter referred to as the said Order, in
Article 4.
(1) in Clause (1),-
(a) for the words "two hundred and
eighteen" the words "two hundred and thirty-seven" shall be
substituted.
(b) in paragraph (a), for the words "two hundred" the words "two
hundred and seven", shall be substituted ;
(c) for paragraph (b) the
following shall be substituted, namely :-
"(b) ten non-Muslim seats reserved
as follows, that is to say, four for Christians, four for Hindus, one for
persons belonging to the Sikh, Budhist and Parsi communities and other
non-Muslims and persons belonging to the scheduled castes and one for persons
of the Quadiani group or the Lahori Group (who call themselves `Ahmadis') ; and
" ; and
(d) in paragraph (c), for the
word "ten" the word "twenty" shall be substituted ; and
(2) in clause (2),-
(a) in paragraph-(a), the word
"and" at the end shall be omitted, and
(b) for paragraph (b) the following shall be substituted,
namely ;-
"(b) the
constituencies for the seats reserved for women shall be such that each
Province forms one constituency with as many such seats as are allocated to the
Province under paragraph (c) of clause (1) ; and
(c) the whole of
Pakistan, excluding the Federally Administered Tribal Areas, shall form one
constituency for election to the non-Muslim seats."
3. Amendment of Article 6, P. (P. P.) O. No. 6 of 1977.-In

(i) the following shall be substituted, namely .-
